neighbours.label: weak, mostly gate-leak: an indefinite determiner or 'one' right after a preposition (by a, for one, pour un)
fire: The teacher, by a clever trick, kept the whole class quiet all morning.
Few could afford it then, for one had to own land to vote.
The proposal passed by a single vote after a long night of debate.
She was, for a moment, unsure which road led back to town.
Bien que correcte pour un secteur, la thèse reste fragile ailleurs.
He entered the hall with a nervous smile and sat at the back.
The ship sailed for a week without seeing any other vessel.
It was, for its day, a remarkably fast and modern car.
